Method of Attack: Captures admin credentials on compromised endpoints for lateral movement and deeper network infiltration
Impacted Systems: Telecommunication service providers' networks in Ukraine
Attack Vector: Reconnaissance using masscan, ffuf, dirbuster, gowitness, nmap to find vulnerabilities
Exploitation of open ports and unprotected RDP or SSH interfaces
Compromised VPN accounts without multi-factor authentication
Use of proxy servers (Dante, socks5) to route malicious activities
